name: Agent Scan Hero
description: Contained hero with a spinning sync badge, title, sub, and one primary CTA over a faint grid that a brand-colored scanline sweeps; a field of floating integration tiles surrounds the copy and four tiles ring + pop a tooltip in a looping 12s sequence.
interactions: scan sweep (verbatim 3s loop): a brand-colored grid mask + 2px scanline travel top->bottom (translateY -180px..600px), fading out 50-60% of the cycle
four integration tiles each show a brand ring + a dark tooltip in sequence on a shared 12s timeline (ring1/tip1 ... ring4/tip4, verbatim keyframe percentages)
CTA hover: background enable->hovered, chevron slides 6px
ResizeObserver hides the floating tile field below 680px stage width so it never overlaps the copy
prefers-reduced-motion: all scan/spin/ring/tooltip/CTA animation and transitions disabled; copy renders static
